title: Admin data export relies on a network allowlist that is not in the repository
description: The admin export route has no role check of its own. A comment says access is limited by an IP allowlist at the load balancer, which the repository does not define.
claimed_root_cause: GET /admin/export authenticates the session but does not check for the admin role; the only stated control is a network allowlist outside the repository.

trace.description: Streams every account record as CSV.

evidence.description: Comment: access restricted by load balancer allowlist.

blockers: Whether the deployed load balancer restricts /admin/export to an allowlist is not in the repository.

validation_plan.deployment: Ask the platform owner to confirm, from the load balancer configuration, which source addresses can reach /admin/export, and whether a signed-in non-admin user on an allowed address can call it.

title: Invoice download returns invoices belonging to other users
description: The invoice download route looks up an invoice by id without checking that it belongs to the signed-in user's account.
root_cause: findInvoiceById selects by primary key only; no ownership predicate is applied on this path.
intended_behavior: A user can download only invoices that belong to their own account.

trace.description: Takes the invoice id from the URL.
Streams the invoice PDF to the caller.

evidence.description: listInvoices applies the account predicate that findInvoiceById lacks.

conditions.description: The caller has an ordinary signed-in session.

execution.attacker_perspective: Dummy user B, signed in, requests an invoice id that belongs to dummy user A.
payloads: GET /invoices/inv_a_001/download with user B's test session
instructions: Regression test test/invoices.ownership.test.ts seeds two dummy accounts and one invoice for account A.
It signs in as user B and requests account A's invoice through the route handler on isolated loopback.
Run inside the sandbox: npm test -- test/invoices.ownership.test.ts
execution.observed_result: The test failed on the untouched source: the handler returned 200 and account A's invoice PDF to user B, where the test expected 404.

remediation.strategy: Apply the account predicate in findInvoiceById, or call it only through an account-scoped query, so the download route cannot read another account's invoice.

likelihood.reason: Any signed-in user can change the id in the URL.

impact.reason: Cross-account read of invoices, which hold names, addresses and amounts.

confidence.reason: Complete source trace and a failing local test reproduced by an independent verifier.

title: Report export builds ORDER BY from a request parameter
description: A scanner flagged string concatenation of the sort parameter into SQL.
claimed_root_cause: The sort query parameter is concatenated into the ORDER BY clause.

trace.description: Concatenates the column into ORDER BY.

evidence.description: sort is checked against a fixed list of column names and replaced with the default otherwise.

reason: The value reaching the query is always one of five fixed column names, so request input cannot change the SQL.
